summary: Caterpillar filed an 8-K reporting a planned leadership transition in its Resource Industries segment. Denise C. Johnson will step down as group president effective Nov. 1, 2026, moving into an advisory role before retiring Feb. 1, 2027, with the board appointing Derrick York, currently president of Solar Turbines, to succeed her effective Nov. 1, 2026. No transaction terms, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine, orderly succession rather than an abrupt or forced departure, so no special-situation classification applies.
